name: Nihilum
storyline:
Célestin and Alexandra are twins whose lives seem ordinary, filled with the usual ups and downs of growing up.

But beneath this familiar world, something feels strangely out of place.

As unexpected events begin to unfold, the twins find themselves caught up in mysteries they never imagined existed. Strange encounters, unanswered questions, and seemingly insignificant details gradually reveal that things might not be quite what they seem.

Some answers may be found in the most unexpected places. Others might only lead to more questions.

And what begins as an ordinary story might turn out to be something entirely different.
summary:
Nihilum is a retro-style RPG following Célestin and Alexandra, two twins living in a world that seems ordinary enough. At least, at first.

As their story unfolds, strange events begin to blur the line between reality, dreams, and something much harder to explain.

Explore different places, meet unusual characters, solve puzzles, fight, and uncover secrets along the way. Some things might seem insignificant, others might not make much sense at first. But there's often more going on than meets the eye.

Nihilum mixes exploration, mystery, humor, and darker moments in a story where not everything is meant to be understood right away.

And perhaps some questions are better left unanswered.
